title: Kepler Reach Rising
author: Sable Kavanagh
blurb: Yara Winterbourne, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
